steps.sql: SELECT "t0"."companyid" AS "companyexperience__companyid", "t0"."personid" AS "companyexperience__personid", "t0"."personname" AS "companyexperience__personname", "t0"."role" AS "companyexperience__role", "t0"."confidence" AS "companyexperience__confidence", "t0"."types" AS "companyexperience__types", "t0"."created_at" AS "companyexperience__created_at", "t0"."_version" AS "companyexperience___version", "t1"."companyid" AS "company__companyid", "t1"."entityname" AS "company__entityname", "t1"."fullname" AS "company__fullname", "t1"."sourcecategory" AS "company__sourcecategory", "t1"."description" AS "company__description", "t1"."summary" AS "company__summary", "t1"."alldescriptions" AS "company__alldescriptions", "t1"."types" AS "company__types", "t1"."motto" AS "company__motto", "t1"."website" AS "company__website", "t1"."logo" AS "company__logo", "t1"."descriptors" AS "company__descriptors", "t1"."foundingdate" AS "company__foundingdate", "t1"."totalinvestment" AS "company__totalinvestment", "t1"."totalinvestmentcurrency" AS "company__totalinvestmentcurrency", "t1"."ispublic" AS "company__ispublic", "t1"."isnonprofit" AS "company__isnonprofit", "t1"."isacquired" AS "company__isacquired", "t1"."isdissolved" AS "company__isdissolved", "t1"."ceoname" AS "company__ceoname", "t1"."foundername" AS "company__foundername", "t1"."metadata_confidence" AS "company__metadata_confidence", "t1"."explicit_origins" AS "company__explicit_origins", "t1"."created_at" AS "company__created_at", "t1"."_version" AS "company___version" FROM "public"."companyexperience" AS "t0" JOIN "public"."company" AS "t1" ON "t0"."companyid" = "t1"."companyid" LIMIT 1000
